# Fee Simple

> Fee Simple is a parcel diligence product from Talos Operations LLC.

## Site

- [Home](https://talosoperations.com/): Product introduction and early-access signup.
- [Coverage](https://talosoperations.com/coverage.html): County coverage map with live and surveyed statuses.
- [Privacy](https://talosoperations.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy.
- [Terms](https://talosoperations.com/terms.html): Terms of service.

## Learn


- [Learn](https://talosoperations.com/learn/): An index of explanations of how North Carolina property records work.
- [How to find out who owns a property in NC from county records](https://talosoperations.com/learn/nc-property-owner-lookup/): How to find a North Carolina property owner from the county tax card and the recorded deed.
- [Deed vs. tax card: why they disagree](https://talosoperations.com/learn/deed-vs-tax-card/): Why the recorded deed and the county tax card can show different owners, and how to check both.
- [Why county ownership records lag behind sales](https://talosoperations.com/learn/county-record-lag/): Why the tax card can still show the previous owner after a new deed is recorded.
- [Grantor vs. grantee: reading a deed index](https://talosoperations.com/learn/grantor-vs-grantee/): What grantor and grantee mean, and how a Register of Deeds index is organized and searched.
- [What is a chain of title, and how is one checked in NC?](https://talosoperations.com/learn/chain-of-title-nc/): How a chain of title is followed through the NC grantor/grantee index, and what a break looks like.
- [Finding the owner behind an LLC-owned property in NC](https://talosoperations.com/learn/llc-property-owner-nc/): How the NC Secretary of State's business registry is used to find who is behind an LLC-owned parcel.
